profile.headline: Software Engineer at Datadog
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer with background in database internals and performance.

At Datadog I help manage one of the biggest data sets in the world.

At Amazon AWS I added time partitioning to Accumulo distributed database and query layers, reducing query times by an order of magnitude.

I co-founded Yellowbrick Data, a startup developing a scale-out SQL database appliance, implementing runtime, code generation, and query internals. Development was on Mac and Linux using gcc and clang.

In the Microsoft SQL division I shipped versions of SQL SSAS through 2008. I helped create the OLE DB and OLE DB for OLAP specs and SDK and the MDX query language. I designed and coded the SSAS client side and many server side components, and the first Excel integration ("slicer"), and led the performance team. I represented the SSAS product in the SQL Customer Advisory Team, helping customers on with bleeding-edge projects.

In the MS Windows performance team, I investigated and drove reduction of memory usage across the OS in Win7 and Win8, and reported findings and improvements to senior management. Ran and managed a thousand-machine measurement system to prevent performance regressions and worked with teams to prevent anomalies from being introduced. The analysis involved big data anomaly detection and drill-down investigation of causes during Win8 and Win10 development.

positions.title: Performance Analyst
positions.description:
Windows division, Fundamentals Performance team.

I worked on Windows performance team, investigating and reporting to senior management. Also helped run a thousand-machine performance measurement system and worked with feature teams to keep performance from degrading. Shipped Win7 and Win8.

positions.title: BI Specialist, Developer, and Program Manger
positions.description: The CAT team works directly with a small set of bleeding edge premier customers, to give insight for other customers and find opportunities for improvement at large scale. I was the first on the team to support Analysis Services, and was in a unique position to directly check in code changes to the shipping product based on findings from customer engagements. Findings were also presented at conferences including PASS (Professional Association for SQL Server).

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description: Part of the core team building and shipping MS SQL Server Analysis Services. One of three engineers on the server team that built the first version, and helped define and implement the MDX query language and OLE DB for OLAP interface. Designed and built storage engine components for SSAS 2005, including indexing and all IO and memory management. Managed the performance team.

positions.description:
ODBC / OLEDB group

Part of the team that defined the OLE DB spec, and implemented the first provider that maps its calls to ODBC (team of 4).
